Rishi —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear asks. A few notes inline: 

- Trial messaging: "14 days / up to 10k tokens" is fine from a catalog perspective; make sure you add "non-accumulative" if you are limiting by token bucket (so customers don't assume monthly). Example: "14-day trial (up to 10k inference tokens, non-accumulative)".

- Pricing footnote: Avoid implying SLA or contract terms in the product page. "Contact for private pricing & enterprise support" is OK but drop the word "Enterprise" if you're planning to allow small teams to contact sales. Suggest: "Contact us for private offers and support".

- DocuSign link: You can surface a scheduling/next-step link, but DocuSign itself should not be presented as an actionable checkout CTA inside product page text. Keep it behind a contact or "Request private offer" button which leads to a form where you include DocuSign in follow-up.

- Compliance/AMI: If you are listing an AMI or BYOAMI, please include a short "Data handling" snippet in the listing. Our catalog ops team (aws-catalog@amazon.com) also requests that you provide the SKU-to-metering mapping in the matrix — the attached XLS looks mostly fine but needs a row for the trial SKU.

I'll copy catalog ops on the matrix update; once you update copy and the trial SKU we'll run a preflight check.

Best,
Will
